unmeasured_triage.detail: The alert text sits on the enclosing Dialog surface (bg-raised), a background set in another file the static rule cannot see. Measured by hand against bg-raised: red-600 on #ffffff (light) = 4.76:1, and the dark variant red-400 on #1e1e21 (dark) = 5.75:1 — both pass 4.5:1.

Initial letter is drawn white on a per-template runtime backgroundColor (template.color, an arbitrary user/data-supplied value). No static analysis can know the background; the correct control is a runtime contrast assertion at the point template colours are defined, tracked as a follow-up (not silently skipped — the pair stays in the gate's unmeasured report every run).
